findings.location: L'été est à nos portes, ... la plupart de ce que l'on appelle localement «the spring work» est terminé.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the quoted English phrase into French rather than leaving it in English. For example: «le travail du printemps» or «les travaux de printemps», depending on intended nuance. Suggested replacement: «la plupart de ce que l'on appelle localement «les travaux de printemps» est terminé.»

findings.location: ... Et lorsque He donna la «Grande Commission», c'était à Ses disciples ...
findings.source_quote: And then when He gave the “Great Commission” it was to His disciples at that time, and to all future disciples—the Church of Jesus Christ.
findings.suggested_fix: The English pronoun He was left in the translation. Replace the English pronoun with the correct French pronoun while preserving capitalization if the translator intends the reverential capital. Suggested fix: «Et lorsque Il donna la «Grande Commission», c'était à Ses disciples de l'époque, et à tous les futurs disciples — l'Église de Jésus-Christ.»
